# Configure the plugin

Use the [configuration guide](https://example.com/config) to create the plugin.

::: warning Read before continuing
Keep the token in `HARNESS_TOKEN`.
:::

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Timeout | Maximum waiting time |

```ts
const timeout = 30
```
